genxml.title: Hub block transfer engine registers and control bits outside the census

struct.name: IIO_WID
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (pinned linux tree): IIO_WID and hubii_wid_u
struct.doc: Widget identification register of the Hub widget. Offset and field layout are from the public header. The header gives no access type and no reset value, so the reset is unknown.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPR
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (pinned linux tree): IIO_ILAPR
struct.doc: Local access protection register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no fields, access type or reset. Access is assumed read and write.

struct.name: IIO_ILAPO
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (pinned linux tree): IIO_ILAPO
struct.doc: Protection override register, named and placed by the public header. The header gives no unlock value or behaviour, so none is imported. Access is assumed write only.

struct.name: IIO_IGFX_1
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_IGFX_1 (offset and name)
struct.doc: Graphics node and widget register 1, the twin of iio_igfx_0 in the census. The header gives both the same field layout: widget number in bits 3:0, node number in bits 12:4, processor number at bit 16 and a valid bit at bit 20. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG0
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_SCRATCH_REG0 (offset and name)
struct.doc: Scratch register 0. The header names its bit uses for software only and gives a mask of the bits that exist, 0x0000000f00f11fff. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_SCRATCH_REG1
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_SCRATCH_REG1 (offset and name)
struct.doc: Scratch register 1, the twin of register 0. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_ITTE
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header (pinned linux tree): IIO_NUM_ITTES, IIO_ITTE_BASE, IIO_ITTE
struct.doc: Big-window translation entry n, for n from 0 to 6. Entry 0 is at the register offset and each later entry is eight bytes further on. Access is an assumption. Reset is unknown.

struct.name: IIO_ICRB_A
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_ICRB_A(x) macro, 15 entries (IIO_NUM_CRBS) four words apart
struct.doc: Word A of the I/O interface's CRB entries. Entry x (0 to 14) is at this offset plus 0x20 times x; the census names entry 0 and a few siblings individually. The header gives no access type, so the access is carried over from the census row of entry 0 (read-write) and is inferred.

struct.name: IIO_ICRB_B
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_ICRB_B(x) macro, 15 entries (IIO_NUM_CRBS) four words apart
struct.doc: Word B of the I/O interface's CRB entries. Entry x (0 to 14) is at this offset plus 0x20 times x; the census names entry 0 and a few siblings individually. The header gives no access type, so the access is carried over from the census row of entry 0 (read-write) and is inferred.

struct.name: IIO_ICRB_C
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_ICRB_C(x) macro, 15 entries (IIO_NUM_CRBS) four words apart
struct.doc: Word C of the I/O interface's CRB entries. Entry x (0 to 14) is at this offset plus 0x20 times x; the census names entry 0 and a few siblings individually. The header gives no access type, so read-only is carried over from the census row of entry 0 and is inferred.

struct.name: IIO_ICRB_D
struct.from: public Linux SN0 Hub I/O header, pinned linux tree: IIO_ICRB_D(x) macro, 15 entries (IIO_NUM_CRBS) four words apart
struct.doc: Word D of the I/O interface's CRB entries. Entry x (0 to 14) is at this offset plus 0x20 times x; the census names entry 0 and a few siblings individually. The header gives no access type, so read-only is carried over from the census row of entry 0 and is inferred.

struct.name: IIO_IBNA_0
struct.doc: Notification address of engine 0, the twin of the engine 1 slot in the census. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_0
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 0. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.

struct.name: IIO_IBIA_1
struct.doc: Interrupt address of engine 1. Offset and name are from the public header. The header gives no access type, so rw is assumed.
